Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.

content.text:
Now I have a complete picture. Here is the full quality review:

---

## Code Quality Review — Commit `77f9059`

### 1. TypeScript Correctness

No TypeScript issues found. All three files use no `any`. Props are implicit via JSX (no explicit prop types needed for zero-prop components). `ISO13485Map` is a valid stub with correct export form. `App.tsx` imports are correctly typed by the router library. **Pass.**

### 2. React Patterns

- Component structure is correct: named exports, no default exports mixed with named.
- No hooks are used in `CertHub` (pure presentational) — appropriate.
- No unnecessary `useEffect`/`useCallback`/`useMemo`.
- `App.tsx` `basename` computation is at render level, not memoized, but it reads from a static env var so this is fine.
- **One issue**: `JourneyMap` still hard-codes `navigate("/station/:id")` (line 36) and `navigate("/")` for close (line 39). The routes were renamed from `/station/:id` to `/ivdr/station/:id` in this commit, but `JourneyMap.tsx` was not updated. This means the "open station" deep-link and "close station" back-navigation in the IVDR journey are now broken — `openStation` navigates to `/station/N` (no longer routed) and `closeStation` navigates to `/` (CertHub, not the IVDR map).

The same stale `/station/:id` path appears in `ConceptPage.tsx` (line 97), `DocumentTree.tsx` (line 240), `DocumentWorkspace.tsx` (lines 89 and 425) — all linking back into the IVDR journey but pointing to the old path.

### 3. Accessibility

- The IVDR card `<Link>` and ISO 13485 card `<Link>` are `<a>` elements rendered as full-height block links. They wrap multiple text nodes without a descriptive `aria-label`, so a screen reader will concatenate all child text as the link name — functionally acceptable but verbose.
- The `<Layers>` icon correctly has `aria-hidden` (line 17). `<Compass>` and `<CheckCircle>` inside the cards do **not** have `aria-hidden` — since they sit inside a `<Link>` alongside visible text, they will be read aloud as "image" by some readers. Low severity but inconsistent with the pattern set by `<Layers>`.
- The `<header>` semantic element wrapping the Hero section (line 12) is appropriate.
- The "인증 카드" section is a `<div>`, not `<section>` — minor; the landmark hierarchy is `main > header, div, section`. The card container being a plain `<div>` is fine.
- The `<Link>` cards have no visible focus ring style (only `hover:shadow-md`). The tokens file defines `--focus-ring` but it is not applied to these interactive elements. Missing focus indicator is a WCAG 2.4.7 failure.

### 4. CSS Token Consistency

Tokens used in `CertHub`:
- `--accent`, `--accent-weak` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--p3`, `--p3-tint` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--surface`, `--border`, `--border-strong` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--text`, `--text-muted` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--t-sm`, `--t-base`, `--t-lg`, `--t-xl`, `--t-2xl`, `--t-3xl` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--s-2`, `--s-4`, `--s-6`, `--s-8`, `--s-12`, `--s-16` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--r-lg`, `--r-md` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--lh-tight`, `--lh-base` — defined in tokens ✓
- `--max-w`, `--margin` — defined in tokens ✓
- **Two hardcoded pixel values**: `padding: "5px 14px"` (badge, line 17) and `padding: "9px 16px"` (button, line 108). The token scale has `--s-1: 4px`, `--s-2: 8px`, `--s-3: 12px`, `--s-4: 16px`. These values (5px, 14px, 9px, 16px) fall between grid steps and deviate from the 8pt/4pt grid rule stated in the token file comment. Minor, but inconsistent with the system.

### 5. Unnecessary Complexity

No over-abstraction. The component is flat and proportionate for a two-card landing page. `ISO13485Map` stub is minimal and correct. `App.tsx` changes are clean. **Pass.**

---

## Summary of Issues

**Blocker (broken navigation):**
- `JourneyMap.tsx` line 36: `navigate(\`/station/${sid}\`)` must become `navigate(\`/ivdr/station/${sid}\`)`
- `JourneyMap.tsx` line 39: `navigate("/")` (closeStation) must become `navigate("/ivdr")` so closing a station returns to the IVDR map, not the hub
- `ConceptPage.tsx` line 97, `DocumentTree.tsx` line 240, `DocumentWorkspace.tsx` lines 89 and 425: all use `to={\`/station/${...id}\`}` — need to be updated to `/ivdr/station/${...id}`

**Should-fix (accessibility):**
- `<Compass>` and `<CheckCircle>` inside card links are missing `aria-hidden`
- Card `<Link>` elements have no focus ring style — `--focus-ring` token should be applied via `:focus-visible` outline

**Minor (token drift):**
- `"5px 14px"` and `"9px 16px"` hardcoded padding values break the 8/4pt grid; replace with nearest token combinations or add a `--s-xs: 5px` alias if 5px is intentional

---

`QUALITY_REVIEW: ⚠️ ISSUES`

- **[Blocker]** Route rename from `/station/:id` to `/ivdr/station/:id` was not propagated: `JourneyMap.tsx` `openStation` and `closeStation` callbacks still use the old paths, and `ConceptPage`, `DocumentTree`, `DocumentWorkspace` all link to `/station/:id` (now 404). This breaks IVDR station deep-linking entirely.
- **[A11y]** `<Compass>` and `<CheckCircle>` icons inside the card links are missing `aria-hidden` (inconsistent with `<Layers>` which correctly has it).
- **[A11y]** Card `<Link>` elements have no `:focus-visible` style — the `--focus-ring` token is defined but unused on these interactive elements, failing WCAG 2.4.7.
- **[Minor]** `"5px 14px"` (badge) and `"9px 16px"` (button) are hardcoded pixel values that break the 8pt/4pt grid the token system enforces; should use token combinations.
